entry.title: The Microservices Hangover: Why 2026 Is the Year of the Sovereign Module
entry.summary:
For years, microservices were the automatic answer to every architectural problem. Break the monolith. Split everything into services. Add an API gateway. Add a service mesh. Add observability. Repeat.
It worked in some cases. It also created a lot of hidden complexity. Now in 2026, something is changing.
